text:
Type: red mosaic area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, traditional
Materials: wool, low flat pile
Colors: deep warm red, pink, orange, cream, teal accents
Shape: rectangle, large central diamond medallion with smaller diamonds, all-over geometric mosaic of small motifs, slim border, medium size, bold visual weight
Feel: warm, vibrant, cozy, lively
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms
